description: Estimate the cost of a task without creating it or charging the account. Pass the model and the full input payload.

input.description: The API 'input' payload to price — the RAW field names the model expects, which differ from the generation tools' parameters. Include prompt and any model-specific fields. For a model's exact field names, read its page via https://docs.unifically.com/llms.txt (they change, so don't go from memory). Translations this server applies on your behalf: music prompt→gpt_description_prompt (+ required mv:'chirp-bluejay', custom:false); TTS voice_id→voice; stt needs audio_url + duration; the generation tools' image_url becomes whichever start-frame field the model wants. A mis-shaped input prices the model's defaults, so keep it faithful to the real call.

model.description: Model id or alias, e.g. 'google/veo-3.1-fast' or 'veo'.
